an8.43:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
an8.43:1.2: atha kho visākhā migāramātā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho visākhaṃ migāramātaraṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.43:1.3: aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato kho visākhe, uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.43:1.4: kathaṃ upavuttho ca visākhe aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro:
an8.43:1.6: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampino viharanti.
an8.43:1.7: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmī.
an8.43:1.8: imipanāhaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi. uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatīti
an8.43:2.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an8.43:2.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an8.43:2.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatīti
an8.43:2.5: evaṃ upavuttho kho visākhe, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāroti. kīva mahapphalo hoti, kīva mahānisaṃso kīva mahājutiko kīva mahāvipphāro:
an8.43:3.2: seyyathāpi visākhe, yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathīdaṃ:
an8.43:3.3: aṅgānaṃ magadhānaṃ kāsīnaṃ kosalānaṃ vajjīnaṃ mallānaṃ cetīnaṃ vaṅgānaṃ kurūnaṃ pañcālānaṃ macchānaṃ sūrasenānaṃ assakānaṃ avantīnaṃ gandhārānaṃ kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an8.43:3.5: kapaṇaṃ visākhe, mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.43:4.1: yāni visākhe, mānusakāni paññāsavassāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.43:4.4: tena saṃvaccharena pañcavassasatāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.43:4.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya
an8.43:4.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.43:4.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.43:5.1: yaṃ visākhe, mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo;
an8.43:5.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an8.43:5.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya,
an8.43:5.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.43:5.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.43:6.7: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasavassasahassāni paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an8.43:6.8: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā paranimmitasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.43:6.9: idaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.43:6.10: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāyāti.
an8.43:7.1: pāṇaṃ na hāne na ca dinnamādiye
an8.43:7.2: musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā
an8.43:8.1: mālaṃ na dhāre na ca gandhamācare
an8.43:9.1: cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā
an8.43:12.1: tasmāhi nārī ca naro ca sīlavā
